legend: The Grey Man of Pawleys Island (South Carolina, USA, hurricane ghost legend)
lines: On Pawleys Island, South Carolina, locals tell of a gentleman in grey.
Legend says he was a young man who died on the road home to his bride.
Now, they say, he walks the beach before every great hurricane.
He appears quietly in a grey coat and hat, and warns those he meets.
In 1822, a woman is said to have met him on her porch.
She listened, and left the island with her family.
The storm tore through, but her house was spared.
They say he walked again before Hazel in 1954 and Hugo in 1989.
Would you listen to a ghost?
title: The Ghost Who Warns Before Every Hurricane #shorts
description:
On Pawleys Island, South Carolina, legend says a ghost in grey appears on the beach before great hurricanes. Those who listen are said to be spared.
